segments.text: We first tried IoT cold-chain sensor in 209. At the time, efficiency needs mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was FX volatility. Without steady power in Port Harcourt, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after IoT cold-chain sensor—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 5 months.
Policy-wise, Tax compliance shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a low-code AutoML gave us clearer demand patterns during Christmas.
